review_method: All219 fresh native PNGs personally inspected at original480x854 resolution in26 call,21 other and9 island2x2 sheets, with selected originals checked separately. resolved_findings: Expanded island spacing and temporary secondary-toolbar/FAB adaptation preserve a usable60dp real app list at320dp width/font1.3; actual contacts and recents images show no header overlap.
Exposed inset background follows actual app palette and restores original drawable on hide/stop.
All four settings compositor captures have native status/navigation pixel contrast, with three consecutive valid samples before saving the exact checked bitmap.

bounded_findings.description: The Hebrew New call caption ellipsizes at font1.3 in the existing emerald/iOS three-column normal grid. Its icon remains fully visible; this was already recorded in beta7.
Intentionally long synthetic contact names ellipsize in bounded caller headers. Numbers and main call controls remain visible.

At font 1.3 the native Hebrew speaker-on caption is ellipsized. Speaker icon and action remain visible; fictional caller identity and call state remain fully legible in the notification body. Freshly observed in both named source7 captures.

Long English contact/favorite labels and secondary recent-call date metadata ellipsize within bounded rows. Primary phone numbers, navigation and call icons remain legible. The existing floating dial control overlaps a low list row/action in these scrollable lists; no new island overlap is present in this baseline subset.

Narrow large-font widget branding and long quick-contact or shape-preview favorite names ellipsize. All four names in each narrow favorites grid remain readable; quick-contact initials and target label remain visible, and all five shape-preview favorites retain distinct avatar positions and readable bounded labels.

The five-icon chooser is scrollable at font 1.3: top captures partly hide the fifth row behind the footer, and bottom captures fully expose it while clipping the first row at the scrolled top. Across each theme pair, all five icon artworks and names are readable.
The English caller ellipsizes in the intentionally compact260dp capsule atfont1.3; fullcaller remains readable after expansion and the phase/timer/controls fit.

The native status-clock icons have low contrast during the first light DEBUG-fixture capture. The capsule and dark native navigation buttons remain readable; the following expanded fixture capture and allfour actual app/settings captures have proper system-bar contrast. This is recorded as a fixture transition limit; no persistent production-screen bar defect is established.
